item.coloph: dad ldan kyi sngags pa tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bskul ngor/ mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa bdag gis dus kyi pho nya zhes bya ba sa pho rta yi hor zla gsum pa'i tshes bzang po (por) stang chen dmu tsha gyer med lung ci bzhin (phab) cing*/ phob yi ge pa ni 'bru rigs tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis bgyis pas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
